Item:Mark of Sheshka

From DDO wiki
Jump to navigation Jump to search


  • Name: Mark of Sheshka
  • Type: This is a raw material used in crafting.
  • Base Value: 000001000010ppPlatinum Piece 
  • Weight: 0.01 lbs
  • Bind: Bound to Account on Acquire
  • Used in: Cauldron of Sora Katra

Description

This token bears the military insignia of a Droaam Warlord: Sheshka, a calm yet fearsome medusa whose kingdom predates the Droaam nation.
